data.exact_reserve_text: For context, during 2024 the actual incurred development was GBP 28.3m against expected development of GBP 8.4m. We have increased reserves on all years. The 2022 and prior gross reserves were increased by GBP 21.3m, partially offset by increased reinsurance recoveries of GBP 4.7m. The increase in reserve is GBP 12.8m gross, GBP 5.1m net of reinsurance. We continue to see adverse development of claims predominantly in respect of two contracts and have strengthened gross (and net) reserves by GBP 5.4m for the 2022 and prior years.

prior_year_events.event_name: Healthcare professional liability portfolio adverse development
prior_year_events.impact_description: Material increase in frequency of severe loss emerged in H2 2024; increased reserves on all years with the 2022 and prior gross reserves increased by GBP 21.3m (partially offset by increased reinsurance recoveries of GBP 4.7m).
A number of claims agreed for settlement on an ex-gratia basis in Q4 2024; increase in reserve of GBP 12.8m gross (GBP 5.1m net of reinsurance).

prior_year_events.event_name: US General Liability contractor portfolio deterioration
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development predominantly in respect of two contracts; strengthened gross (and net) reserves by GBP 5.4m for the 2022 and prior years.

Actual incurred development GBP 28.3m against expected development of GBP 8.4m; increased gross reserves on 2022 and prior by GBP 21.3m (reinsurance recoveries +GBP 4.7m).

data.standardized_narrative: During 2024 the syndicate recorded adverse prior-year reserve development driven principally by a material increase in severe claims frequency in its healthcare professional liability portfolio, ex-gratia aviation war settlements arising from the Russia/Ukraine conflict, and deterioration in a US general liability contractor portfolio. Management increased 2022-and-prior gross reserves by GBP 39.5m in aggregate (healthcare GBP 21.3m + aviation GBP 12.8m + US GL GBP 5.4m), partially offset by reinsurance recoveries, resulting in a net strengthening of prior-year reserves of c.13.6% relative to opening gross claims outstanding.

data.data_quality_notes: Report financial statements are presented in USD. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 31 Dec 2023 = $368,826k) and converted to GBP using start-of-period/end-of-period GBP rates (0.79) from Note 26 to produce opening_reserves_gbp_m. Prior-year development (39.5) was derived from narrative GBP amounts cited in the Year of Account Commentary (healthcare GBP 21.3m, aviation GBP 12.8m, US GL GBP 5.4m). Gross premiums and claims triangle are in USD and returned in native currency. Conversion applied only where narrative provided GBP figures and where field name explicitly requested GBP; otherwise amounts kept in native USD. Prior-year development is gross (insurance liabilities) as described in the narrative; no single formal 'movement in prior year's provision' table with a consolidated gross line was found.
